## Closing as a duplicate of 66af (code half) + 43ea (rotation half)

Same defect as 66af: a bearer credential for the review-bot passed in the query string and
landed in the HTTP access log for /webhook and /rerun. f7f0 was filed about 15h after 66af
and carries no independent scope.

Disposition of this ticket's four ACs:
- AC1 (sentinel credential absent from logs) and AC2 (valid auth still succeeds, invalid
  rejected) are satisfied by the landed 66af change, commit 4e8c83c833, Gerrit change 1384,
  MERGED with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. In-tree: X-Rebar-Token header auth in
  src/rebar/review_bot/app.py, TokenRedactingFilter plus install_access_log_redaction in
  src/rebar/review_bot/config.py, tests in tests/unit/test_review_bot_token_redaction.py.
- AC3 (production credential rotated after the fix deploys) and AC4 (retained journal
  exposure assessed, cleanup receipt recorded) are satisfied by the completed rotation and
  purge, attested by the operator in this session. AC4's journal/exposure assessment is
  carried by 43ea, which is the rotation ticket of record.

Linked f7f0 -duplicates-> 66af. No engineering work is lost by this close: the preventive
store-side guard is tracked separately on e7a9.
